svg.title: Remmich logo — 3 by 3 card group — colored glass — stronger glass v2
svg.desc: Five colorful rounded moment cards fill a spaced three-by-three mosaic: a two-by-two square, one small top-right square, one vertical right card, and two small bottom cards. Clear uniform tints, fine colored edges, tapered corner reflections and subtle transmitted shadows. Original geometry and layout retained; transparent background. Stronger local corner reflections and an exterior colored caustic; uniform surface tint.
